title: AEP component map
note: The 18 main components in the order and with the names of the AEP page. Every folder under AEP-Components sits in exactly one row or in the list of shared parts. The README check of aep-check.mjs reads this file.

components.name: AEP Base Node
components.summary: The local governance kernel that opens every sealed capsule, judges it and applies only what it allows.

components.name: UCB
components.summary: The Universal Connect Bridge, the airlock that brings the work of an external system to the Base Node as a sealed capsule.

components.name: One Validation Envelope
components.summary: The one container in which every validation target of an action is checked in a single pass.

components.name: Admit Gate
components.summary: The pass that collects every wall of an action, judges them together and denies by default.

components.name: Graph Engine
components.summary: The workflow runner that moves a run through its nodes and saves a checkpoint after each one.

components.name: GAP
components.summary: Governed Agentic Programming, the instruction language in which every policy and agent profile is written.

components.name: dynAEP
components.summary: The runtime for time rules and causal event order, with the hyperlattice as its policy wrap.

components.name: Lattice Channels
components.summary: The encrypted transport on which every message travels to the Base Node as a sealed capsule.

components.name: Evidence Ledger
components.summary: The hash chained audit record with Merkle proofs that a later reader can verify.

components.name: Base Node Pulse
components.summary: The compiled 1000 ms interval that freezes a capsule at its seal before the checks run.

components.name: CAWs
components.summary: The host sandboxes in which an agent process runs under the written policy.

components.name: Scanners
components.summary: The content scanners that read the text of a proposal for secrets, personal data, injection and more.

components.name: AgentMesh
components.summary: The identity layer that issues certificates and identifiers for agents on the local node.

components.name: Economics
components.summary: Cost estimation before a model call, budget caps and x402 payments.

components.name: Lattice Memory
components.summary: The store of the shapes of validated proposals, kept for audit, health telemetry and lookup.

components.name: Intent Ledger
components.summary: The append-only record that links the declared intent of a code change to the commit that carried it out.

components.name: Model Gateway
components.summary: The governed route for model calls to several providers, with checks on the stream.

components.name: TLA+
components.summary: The formal models of the kernel rules and the checker that keeps them in step with the code.

shared.role: A file based store of evaluation datasets with simple versions.
Enforced draft environments, in which a coding agent changes a repository only through a scanned draft.
Shared path helpers and the catalog of regulation modules that several components import.
The Universal Computation Module, the exact calculation engine with signed receipts.
